notes: Primary source: Montgomery County Board of Elections '2026 Montgomery County Candidate Report' (dated Friday, October 16, 2026) and 'November 3, 2026 Ballot Issues' list (dated Friday, September 11, 2026). The board site (mcboe.org redirects to montgomery.boe.ohio.gov) sits behind a Cloudflare check that blocks curl/WebFetch; it cleared on its own in the built-in browser (no CAPTCHA was clicked) and the two PDFs were downloaded from there. Judicial office names are as the board prints them ('Judge of the Court of Common Pleas (1) Term Begins ...'); the board does not label the General Division seats. The board lists judges, the New Lebanon council race and all judicial candidates without party. Statewide offices, U.S. House (10th), State Senate 5, State Reps 36-40, 2nd District Court of Appeals and State Issue 3 are omitted per RULES.md. Local option 'Question 2' = Sunday sales; 'Question 1' = sale of intoxicating liquor (standard Ohio 5-R local-option question numbering; the board list gives only the question number). Dayton Daily News (Aug 5, 2026) corroborates the nine tax issues and reports Jackson Twp levy ~$275,842/yr, Jefferson Twp ~$337,882/yr, DPS ~$14.6M/yr.
